content.title: In the March of 10 Million Duroods over 10 Days, Send Your Heart’s Devotion to Madinah
content.subtitle: Let your tear-touched Durood join this historic caravan of love
content.body:
As the exhaustion of the day settles and you rest in the quiet stillness, close your eyes and reflect upon that noble soul. Fourteen and a half centuries ago, in a secluded room in Madinah, his prayer mat was soaked with tears through countless silent nights. He asked for no worldly comfort; his trembling lips carried only one desperate cry: "Ummati, ya Rabbi Ummati!" (My Ummah, O my Lord, my Ummah!). One day, his eyes welled with tears before his Companions, and he exclaimed, "How I long to meet my brothers!" Astonished, the Companions asked, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, are we not your brothers?" He gently replied, "You are my companions; my brothers are those who will come after me, who believe in me and love me without ever seeing me" (Sahih Muslim: 249).

The Only Sanctuary on That Terrifying Day

In the Noble Quran, Allah warns us of that harrowing Day when a person will flee from their own brother, mother, father, spouse, and children (Surah Abasa: 34–36). Under a scorching sun, billions of souls will tremble with unbearable thirst and dread, crying out in utter helplessness, "Nafsi, nafsi!" (Myself, myself!). Even the greatest Messengers will say, "Today my Lord is angry as never before, and I fear only for myself." Yet at that very moment, one man will fall in prostration beneath the Divine Throne. Seeing his weeping, Allah will say: "O Muhammad, raise your head. Ask, and it will be granted; intercede, and it will be accepted" (Sahih Bukhari: 4712; Sahih Muslim: 194). When our entry to Jannah rests upon his intercession, will our hearts not overflow with gratitude and love for our beloved Prophet ﷺ?

A Caravan of Love Bound for Madinah

The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever sends blessings upon him once, Allah sends ten mercies upon them and wipes away ten of their sins (Sunan an-Nasa'i: 1297). For nearly 12 years, Muslims Day has walked beside you in the journey to become better Muslims. To ignite the flame of prophetic love within our hearts, we present a landmark initiative: the "10 Million Durood Challenge." Standing united with millions across the globe over the next 10 days, we will send an extraordinary offering of 10 million Duroods to Madinah. Imagine the Day of Judgment: when a radiant vessel filled with millions of Duroods is presented before our beloved Prophet ﷺ, and your name shines brightly among those tearful gifts of love—what a moment that will be!

How to Join and Participate

  • Open the Link: Click the button in the footer to access the live Durood counter.

  • Add Durood Easily: Tap the "Add Durood" button to count each recitation. You can also tap the expand icon to switch to full screen, allowing you to tap anywhere on the screen to add a Durood automatically.

  • Add Offline Recitations: If you have already recited offline, select the +10, +33, or +100 shortcuts to log your count instantly.

  • Track the Leaderboard: Scroll down to view top-contributing countries and cities, and follow your community's progress.

  • 10-Day Window: This blessed initiative lasts only 10 days; make every spare moment count in this sacred endeavor.

footer_button.hint: Before drifting off to sleep, let us return his profound love with a heartfelt gift. Open the link, log your Durood, and let your voice reach the Prophet’s ﷺ Rawdah.
